title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy — Antimicrobial Treatment and Water Category
content:
Standing water degrades from clean to grey to black, and under the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy the antimicrobial treatment fee on a mold remediation payment follows how long the water stood before the first notice.

**The rule.** An antimicrobial treatment fee is added at a percentage of the mold replacement-cost value by how long the water stood before the first notice: 8 percent when the loss was reported more than 7 days after the date of loss, 4 percent when it was reported 3 to 7 days after it, and nothing when it was reported within 2 days, when the water is still clean.

The mold replacement-cost value is the replacement-cost value recorded on the claim's repeated-seepage denial entry for the mold remediation. The time the water stood is counted in whole days from the date of loss to the report date, both as recorded on the claim's first-notice entry.

The fee is added to the mold payment figure and forms part of the whole mold figure, so it counts inside the ceiling of the package's mold limit less the mold money already issued on the policy for losses with a date of loss in the 12 months before the call; the floor at 0.00 and the single rounding to the cent are taken after it is added.

### Training questions

**Q. The first notice records a date of loss of the 10th and a report date of the 12th. What applies?**
A. Two whole days: reported within 2 days, clean water, no antimicrobial fee.

**Q. Date of loss the 10th, reported the 13th?**
A. Three days: grey water, 4 percent of the mold replacement-cost value.

**Q. Date of loss the 10th, reported the 17th?**
A. Seven days: still within 3 to 7 days, grey water, 4 percent.

**Q. Date of loss the 10th, reported the 18th?**
A. Eight days: more than 7 days, black water, 8 percent.

**Q. A loss reported the same day it happened?**
A. Zero days: within 2 days, no fee.

**Q. On a hypothetical mold replacement-cost value of 6250.00, what are the amounts?**
A. 8 percent is 500.00; 4 percent is 250.00; within 2 days, nothing.

### Summary

| Whole days from date of loss to report date | Water category | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | Clean | None |
| 3 to 7 | Grey | 4 percent of the mold replacement-cost value |
| More than 7 | Black | 8 percent of the mold replacement-cost value |
